name: Operator Forensics
description: Method for a Prime to investigate and safely act on an unfamiliar operational task: locate the authoritative definition, probe read-only, dry-run a guarded tool, verify by re-derivation, and scope tightly. Uses existing shell/scripting/gcloud + the guarded operator tools; declares no new command.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: Before an unfamiliar or irreversible operational action — deleting data, wiping an agent's memory, editing runtime state — when you don't yet know the exact data model, path, or safe procedure. Investigate first; never guess or refuse.
